candidate_replacement.hidden_definitions_description: Before compilation the evaluator renames these fixed definitions, which implement the target's behavior, in every source file, so a submission cannot reuse them by name.

test_programs.policy: Run the pinned upstream word load and store tests to check the load writeback path and the cacheable store data and byte enables through readback.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches.
